additional_info.subject: RE: 0386592 - ID0386592-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / P9 312561850/11]  RFID authentication problem. CRM:02023000244
additional_info.body:
Dear Romain,
We have checked the charger on SCB and found that it is offline from February 2024. Unfortunately, we are unable to perform any further analysis remotely without an active SCB connection.
As a next step, could you please try performing a hard reset via the OCPP server if the charger is connected on OCPP. If a remote reset from OCPP is not possible, a local reboot will be necessary to bring the charger back online and once the charger is online on SCB, you can try charging via RFID card and provide us timestamps if you encountered the same error again so we can analyze the logs.
Additionally, it is important to ensure that the RFID is added to the OCPP backend, If the authorization doing through the OCPP and If the authorization doing through a local, then these RFID's to be added in local list.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vikas Khiladkar
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
